ConnectionStrings.//: Non-secret defaults only (04-Infrastructure.md section 4). The deployed connection string arrives as the ConnectionStrings__Default environment variable, built from POSTGRES_USER and POSTGRES_PASSWORD in compose. The development value lives in appsettings.Development.json. Never put a credential in this file: it ships inside the image, so anyone who can pull the image has the database password.

App.//: The externally reachable origin of the front end. Invitation and password-reset emails build their links from this, so a wrong value produces emails whose links go nowhere -- and the token is single-use, so the person is stuck until a new one is issued. Supplied as App__BaseUrl in deployment.

DataProtection.//: Where cookie signing keys are persisted. Must be a mounted volume: with ephemeral keys every deploy and every container restart signs out every user, which gets reported as 'the app logs me out randomly'. Startup fails if this is blank or the path is not writable -- deliberately, because the in-memory fallback works perfectly in testing.

Seeding.//: The first Accountant Admin, created only when no AccountantAdmin exists at all. Both values are blank here on purpose: there is NO built-in default admin password. Supplied in deployment as Seeding__FirstAdminEmail and Seeding__FirstAdminPassword (ACCOUNTANT_ADMIN_EMAIL / ACCOUNTANT_ADMIN_PASSWORD in compose). The seeded account is forced to change its password on first login, because an environment variable is visible in docker inspect and in shell history.

DueDateScanner.//: The due-date reminder scanner (Tickets plan section 9a). OFF BY DEFAULT: AddTicketsSlice calls AddHostedService only when Enabled is true, which is what keeps a background loop out of the test host and out of a developer's F5. It must run in exactly ONE replica. LeadTimeDays is how many days before the due date the Assignee is reminded, inclusive of the boundary day; ScanIntervalHours is one pass per day, because a due date is a calendar day and a second pass on the same day is a no-op.
